name: 33166 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33166 (Miami) has 176 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33166 (Miami) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
52% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33166 (Miami) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 46 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
